events.kraken-surume-tamed: Luffy, Zoro and Sanji defeat the kraken, and Luffy tames it, naming it Surume.
events.sanji-nosebleed-mermaid-cove: Sanji nearly bleeds to death from a nosebleed at the sight of the mermaids.
events.shirahoshi-meets-luffy: Luffy meets Princess Shirahoshi in the Hard Shell Tower.
events.zoro-vs-hody-ryugu-palace: Zoro faces Hody Jones at the Ryugu Palace.
events.jinbe-reunites-luffy: Jinbe reunites with Luffy in the Sea Forest.
events.fisher-tiger-frees-slaves: Fisher Tiger scales the Red Line, storms Mary Geoise and frees the slaves.
events.fisher-tiger-death: Fisher Tiger dies after refusing a transfusion of human blood.
events.jinbe-vs-arlong-sun-pirates-split: The Sun Pirates split up and Jinbe confronts Arlong.
events.otohime-assassination: Queen Otohime is shot dead; years later it is revealed that Hody did it.
events.luffy-vs-jinbe: Luffy and Jinbe fight in the Sea Forest over the plan to stop Hody.
events.hody-reveals-otohime-murder: Hody confesses at Conchcorde Plaza that he killed Otohime.
events.straw-hats-vs-100000: The ten face the 100,000 New Fish-Man Pirates at Conchcorde Plaza; Luffy brings down 50,000 with Conqueror's Haki.
events.sunny-gaon-cannon: Franky unveils the Sunny's secret weapons, including the Gaon Cannon.
events.general-franky: Franky debuts the General Franky robot.
events.red-hawk-debut: Luffy debuts the Red Hawk, a fiery punch with Armament Haki.
events.elephant-gatling-stops-noah: Luffy smashes the ark Noah with the Elephant Gatling (Gear Third with Haki).
events.jinbe-blood-transfusion: Jinbe donates blood to Luffy, breaking the law that kept humans and fish-men apart.
events.shirahoshi-is-poseidon: Shirahoshi is revealed to be Poseidon, one of the Ancient Weapons.
events.akainu-new-fleet-admiral: Akainu is revealed to be the new Fleet Admiral.
events.luffy-declares-war-big-mom: Luffy declares Fish-Man Island his territory and challenges Big Mom.
